changelog.title: SteamLite 6.0.0 - Final Release
items: SUE Editor Enabled: Create custom layouts, add widgets, and morph the UI however you want.
Custom Themes: Import and export your UI themes as JSON files.
Floating Add Non-Steam Game button in the library.
GitHub-powered News & Announcements section on the Home page.
Various bug fixes and performance improvements.
CRITICAL NOTICE: SteamLite has been officially discontinued as of Saturday, July 11 at 00:00. Remote services are shutting down.

news.title: SteamLite Has Been Discontinued
news.content: As of Saturday, July 11 at 00:00, SteamLite has been officially discontinued. There will be no further updates or support. Thank you for using the application.
